questiontext.text: Why must Holocaust evidence be corroborated across different source types?

answer.text: Victim testimony, perpetrator records, photographs, artifacts, and demographic evidence together establish context and counter distortion.
One anonymous claim is always sufficient.
Only government documents can reveal human experience.
Corroboration eliminates the need to examine source purpose.

Ignore its origin because all primary sources are equally reliable.
Use only the title and skip the source details.
